decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk line extends the firm's established office competence, serves growing workplace demand and has its own page, so results likely meet aspirations and give no trigger for problemistic search.
The chair family sits close to the core offer and uses existing craft and distribution resources, so carrying it costs little and the risk of a shortfall against aspirations is low.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory with uncertain results, but they share materials with the rug line, and a firm that is hiring has enough slack to give them more time.
The upholstered sofa is only mentioned on the website, which suggests modest visibility, but it fits the core living range, so the firm will likely keep it unless sales clearly miss aspirations.
The high standing table is close to the established offer, has its own page and fits the flexible-workplace direction, so there is little reason to drop it.

Although the rug collection is distant from the core, management presents it as a flagship of its direction, and slack from a stable, hiring firm lets it carry uncertain early results rather than withdraw it after one year.
